metadata.title: Nepali Black sesame and potato salad
metadata.description:
This humble black sesame potato salad is something I learnt during my hostel days from a Nepali friend — and it’s stayed with me ever since.

Earthy, nutty, tangy and bold — it’s one of those dishes that comes together so easily, yet leaves such a lasting flavour.

**How to make it:**  
Cube some boiled potatoes.  
Add roasted and pounded black sesame seeds — this gives it that beautiful deep, toasty flavour.  
In a separate pan, heat mustard oil, temper some onions and green chillies until fragrant.  
Pour this over the potato and sesame mixture.  
Finish with a generous squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Mix well.

It’s simple, punchy, and honestly—comfort in every bite.
